integrity: Symbolic identities are proved in the text and replayed by exact rational series arithmetic; numerical root evaluation is used only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The exact global fixed-prior optimizer formula is a published premise; the new result concerns its regularity at the crossover and its higher-order large-exponent expansion.
The statement is restricted to prior \(1/2\) and does not assert an analogous cusp for the unrestricted-prior profile.
title: Cusp and second-order tail of the sharp coherent-disagreement moment profile
